summary: OpenStream-IRL APK builds, Android checks pass, and all eight relay/browser checks pass. The disk-backed relay is running on the Linux box without cloud storage or a credit card. Its private HTTPS route needs one admin command. Real-phone feedback is pending.

items.title: Separate Android app
items.detail: OpenStream-IRL installs as dev.openstream.irl alongside OpenStream. APK build, JVM checks, and Android lint pass.

items.title: Camera and microphone segments
items.detail: H.264/AAC MPEG-TS segments with keyframes. Native mux output decodes with FFmpeg; phone capture awaits feedback.

items.title: Disk queue and upload retries
items.detail: Phone saves closed segments, retries lost acknowledgements, and drains backlogs in bursts. Capture stops at the queue limit.

items.title: Saved private pairing
items.detail: Pair once with separate publish and viewing credentials. The phone saves its connection.

items.title: OBS browser receiver
items.detail: HLS playback with a 6–30 second recovery delay. Synthetic video decoded in a browser; initial connection retry is covered.

items.title: Disk-backed authenticated relay
items.detail: Node relay authenticates ordered uploads, persists pairing and video on disk, and prunes idle video. Five real-HTTP checks pass.

items.title: Linux box hosting
items.detail: Persistent user service is active and serves the pairing page. Session creation works on Node 22; no R2 or credit card is needed.

items.title: Enable private HTTPS access
items.detail: One Linux-box admin command remains: sudo tailscale serve --bg --https=8443 http://127.0.0.1:8796. Existing port-443 service is preserved.

items.title: Wi-Fi and mobile-data handoffs
items.detail: User to verify continuous picture, automatic recovery, and queued uploads on real mobile networks.

items.title: Real-phone picture and audio
items.detail: Verify camera start, framing, microphone audio, and lip-sync in OBS on the user's Android phone.

items.title: Long-session reliability
items.detail: Measure temperature, battery use, storage growth, and audio drift over an extended real session.

items.title: Background and screen-off capture
items.detail: Current build requires the camera screen open. A foreground capture service is not implemented.

items.title: Automatic bitrate adaptation
items.detail: Manual 1–12 Mbps selection is implemented. Automatic changes based on mobile bandwidth are pending.

items.title: Automatic orientation
items.detail: Video uses the sensor's native orientation. Rotate in OBS as needed; automatic pixel rotation is pending.
